description: Shared cases for figure grounding. ClaimsAssist's GroundingVerifier withholds any sentence whose figures (numbers, dates, claim ids) are not found in its sources; PilotGate re-checks shown answers independently. Both run these cases (ClaimsAssist.Tests GroundingTests, PilotGate.Tests FigureGroundingTests), so the two implementations cannot drift. Written and reviewed by hand; derived from replaying 129 real answers of gate runs 1, 3, 5, 6 and R1.

verify.answer: Burst pipes are covered [KB-HR-AVB#insured-perils]. The limit is 7,000 EUR.

assemble.note: Sources are exactly what the model saw: a cited document counts with its attributes (title, section) and text; a searched but uncited document does not.
assemble.question: Does storm cover apply, and what about fire?
tool_results:
<document chunk_id="KB-HR-AVB#storm" title="Hausrat AVB 2024" section="§ 3 Storm" applies_to="hausrat" source="approved">
Storm means air movement of at least wind force 8.
</document>
<document chunk_id="KB-HR-AVB#fire" title="Hausrat AVB 2024" section="§ 2 Fire" applies_to="hausrat" source="approved">
Fire damage is covered up to 50.000 EUR.
</document>
assemble.answer: Under § 3 of the AVB 2024, storm means wind force 8 or more [KB-HR-AVB#storm]. Fire is covered up to 50,000 EUR.
assemble.expect_text: Under § 3 of the AVB 2024, storm means wind force 8 or more [KB-HR-AVB#storm].
